description: Safe service procedures by module with risk levels and safety pre-conditions

services.name: Reset All Adaptations
services.confirmationPrompt: Are you sure you want to reset all engine fuel trim and learned throttle adaptations? The vehicle may idle slightly roughly during initial relearn drive.
services.description: Clears learned fuel trim values, throttle body position offsets, and adaptive idle control tables.

services.name: Halt Transmission Adaptive Learning
services.confirmationPrompt: This will pause automatic clutch and shift pressure adaptive learning until the next ignition cycle.
services.description: Temporarily freezes adaptive shift scheduling and clutch fill times for diagnostic evaluation.

services.name: Misfire Monitor Neutral Profile Correction
services.confirmationPrompt: Resets the crankshaft position sensor tooth variation table stored in PCM. Requires an uninterrupted decel fuel shut-off drive cycle after completion.
services.description: Resets mechanical crankshaft sensor profile learning after clutch, flywheel, or sensor replacement.

services.name: Module Reboot
services.confirmationPrompt: Performing ECU Hard Reset on Powertrain Control Module. The module will temporarily cycle offline and re-initialize.
services.description: Sends UDS Service 0x11 (ECUReset HardReset) to reboot the engine ECU.

services.name: Module Reboot
services.confirmationPrompt: Reboot the Ford SYNC APIM infotainment system? The center screen will restart.
services.description: Performs a soft/hard restart of the SYNC console unit to resolve bluetooth or screen freeze issues.

services.name: Module Reboot
services.description: Restarts the parking aid controller to reset temporary sensor fault states.

services.name: Rear Camera Calibration
services.confirmationPrompt: Ensure vehicle is parked on a flat surface with parking guidelines unobstructed before starting camera calibration.
services.description: Initiates dynamic or static alignment routine for reverse camera guideline trajectory.

services.name: Local Interconnect Network New Module Calibration
services.confirmationPrompt: This will register new LIN bus slave devices (e.g. alternator regulator, wiper motor, battery sensor) with BCM.
services.description: Teaches the BCM addressing and calibration for newly replaced LIN sub-bus actuators.

services.name: Tire pressure monitor learning mode
services.confirmationPrompt: Enter TPMS sensor relearn mode? The horn will chirp once when learning mode is active.
services.description: Puts BCM TPMS receiver into 125kHz training mode to pair wheel sensor RF IDs (LF, RF, RR, LR).
